test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The money shall have been withdrawn from the bank by tomorrow.

options.text: We are going to withdraw the money from the bank by tomorrow.
We shall withdraw the money from the bank by tomorrow.
We shall have withdrawn the money from the bank by tomorrow.
We shall be withdrawing the money from the bank by tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **'We shall have withdrawn the money from the bank by tomorrow.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the passive voice of the Future perfect tense.
 
• Future perfect tense: The future perfect is a verb tense used for actions that will be completed before some other point in the future.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• (Active voice) Subject+ will/shall+ have+ the third form of verb+ object
 
• (Passive voice) Object+ will/shall+have+been+ the third form of verb.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• She will have won the first prize. (Active voice)
 
 
• Here, the subject is 'she', the object is 'the first prize' the main verb is 'won' which is the third form of the verb 'win'. To convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject and object will change their places and will be connected with a linking verb followed by the third form of the main verb.
 
 
 
• The first prize will have been won by her. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• Since the subject of the sentence isn't given we will look at the options.
 
• Thus, in the above-given sentence, the object of the sentence i.e. **'The money'** will exchange its place with the subject of the sentence i.e.** 'we',** and will be connected with the linking verb and the third form of the main verb.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** option 3.**

 

Correct sentence:__ *We shall have withdrawn the money from the bank by tomorrow.*
